description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.
The code of the service to which the instance belongs.

The duration of the subscription renewal. Unit: months. Valid values:

*   1 to 9
*   12
*   24
*   36
